series.name: Lynx Smart BMS — error codes (VictronConnect / GX device)
series.notes: Text codes of the form E-Bxx reported in VictronConnect, on a GX device and on VRM. Self-contained series because these are structured alphanumeric codes, not LED flash counts (see the Lynx Status-LED series for the panel-side reading). The 'B' in the code means the battery/BMS domain; the Lynx NG variants add D (Distributor) and C (cell) domains. Related warning (W-Bxx) and alarm (A-Bxx) codes are deliberately NOT in this series.

meaning.en: The BMS could not initialise from the battery pack.
meaning.ur: BMS battery pack se initialize nahi hua.

causes.en: One or more batteries not properly connected
causes.ur: Koi aik ya zyada batteries theek se nahi jury

causes.en: Inter-battery communication link broken in the chain
causes.ur: Batteries ke darmiyan communication link toota hua hai

solutions.en: Isolate DC, then walk the battery chain and confirm every battery-to-battery lead is seated.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein, phir battery chain check karein ke har battery-to-battery lead poori tarah lagi hui hai.

solutions.en: Measure continuity across each inter-battery link to find the open one.
solutions.ur: Har inter-battery link ki continuity nikaal kar khuli wala dhoondein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes

meaning.en: The BMS has no battery connected to it.
meaning.ur: BMS se koi battery jury nahi hai.

causes.en: BMS cable loop is not closed
causes.ur: BMS cable loop band nahi hai

causes.en: No battery connected, or battery cables disconnected
causes.ur: Koi battery nahi jury, ya battery cables disconnect hain

solutions.en: Isolate DC, then verify the BMS cable loop is closed from end to end.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein, phir BMS cable loop sifar se sifar band hai ya nahi check karein.

solutions.en: Measure the loop resistance and continuity; an open loop confirms the fault.
solutions.ur: Loop ki resistance aur continuity nikaalein; khula loop fault confirm karta hai.

solutions.en: Reseat the last connector in the chain, which is the usual culprit.
solutions.ur: Chain ka aakhri connector dobara lagaayein, jo aam tor par asal wajah hoti hai.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes

title.en: Invalid number of batteries in the pack
title.ur: Pack mein batteries ki ghalat tadaad hai

meaning.en: The BMS has detected a battery count that does not match its configuration.
meaning.ur: BMS ne battery ki aik aisi tadaad dhoondi hai jo uski configuration se match nahi karti.

causes.en: Not all batteries properly connected, so the BMS counts fewer than configured
causes.ur: Tamam batteries theek se nahi jury, is liye BMS configured se kam ginti karta hai

causes.en: Battery count setting wrong in VictronConnect
causes.ur: VictronConnect mein battery count setting ghalat hai

solutions.en: Isolate DC and count the actual batteries in the series string.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein aur series string mein asal batteries gin lein.

solutions.en: Check the configured battery count in VictronConnect against that count.
solutions.ur: VictronConnect mein configured battery count ko us gin se compare karein.

solutions.en: Fix any disconnected battery, then correct the count setting.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi disconnect battery theek karein, phir count setting theek karein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes

title.ur: Battery voltage ki ijazat nahi hai

meaning.en: The battery voltage is too high or too low for the configured system. The manual notes this occurs when the voltage is outside all system voltage ranges.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage configured system ke liye bohat zyada ya kam hai. Manual ke mutabiq ye tab hota hai jab voltage sab system voltage ranges se bahar ho.

causes.en: Bank voltage outside the 12/24/48 V system threshold window
causes.ur: Bank voltage 12/24/48 V system ki threshold window se bahar

causes.en: Battery settings in VictronConnect set to the wrong system voltage
causes.ur: VictronConnect mein battery settings ghalat system voltage par hain

solutions.en: Measure the actual bank voltage with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se asal bank voltage nikaalein.

solutions.en: Compare to the threshold table: 12 V = 9-15 V, 24 V = 16-30 V, 48 V = 32-60 V.
solutions.ur: Threshold table se compare karein: 12 V = 9-15 V, 24 V = 16-30 V, 48 V = 32-60 V.

solutions.en: Correct the battery voltage setting in VictronConnect.
solutions.ur: VictronConnect mein battery voltage setting theek karein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes

meaning.en: A hardware fault inside the BMS. Victron's stated remedy is dealer contact.
meaning.ur: BMS ke andar hardware fault. Victron ka bataya hua hal dealer se rabta karna hai.

causes.en: Internal board or processor failure
causes.ur: Internal board ya processor ki failure

causes.en: Component failure after surge, heat or water ingress
causes.ur: Surge, garmi ya paani ke ghusaav ke baad component failure

solutions.en: Isolate DC, then verify the installation and all cables are sound before assuming a board fault.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein, phir board fault maan lene se pehle installation aur cables theek check karein.

solutions.en: Contact your Victron dealer and quote the exact code E-B11.
solutions.ur: Victron dealer se rabta karein aur asal code E-B11 batayein.

solutions.en: Keep the BMS powered from a stable supply while the dealer assesses it.
solutions.ur: Dealer dekh raha ho tab tak BMS ko stable supply se power dete rahein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes

title.en: Pre-charge error - load resistance too low
title.ur: Pre-charge error - load resistance bohat kam hai

meaning.en: The load resistance is too low for the BMS to pre-charge the loads.
meaning.ur: Load resistance itni kam hai ke BMS loads ko pre-charge nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: One or more loads with very low resistance connected
causes.ur: Bohat kam resistance wala koi ya koi load jury hai

causes.en: Inverter/charger input capacitance too large for the pre-charge circuit
causes.ur: Inverter/charger ki input capacitance pre-charge circuit ke liye bohat badi hai

solutions.en: Isolate DC, then disconnect or reduce some DC loads as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein, phir manual ke mutabiq kuch DC loads disconnect ya kam karein.

solutions.en: Measure the resistance across the load output to find the low-resistance path.
solutions.ur: Load output par resistance nikaal kar kam resistance wala raasta dhoondein.

solutions.en: Reconnect loads one at a time until pre-charge succeeds on all of them.
solutions.ur: Loads ek ek kar ke jurayein jab tak sab par pre-charge na ho jaye.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes

meaning.en: The safety contactor has not behaved correctly. Victron's stated remedy is dealer contact.
meaning.ur: Safety contactor ne theek se kaam nahi kiya. Victron ka bataya hua hal dealer se rabta karna hai.

causes.en: Contactor failed to close, or welded closed
causes.ur: Contactor band nahi hua, ya band hi reh gaya (welded)

causes.en: Contactor drive or control fault
causes.ur: Contactor drive ya control fault

solutions.en: Isolate DC, then measure the main contacts for continuity to see if they are welded.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein, phir main contacts ki continuity nikaal kar dekhein ke weld to nahi hue.

solutions.en: Check the coil supply and connector seating at the contactor.
solutions.ur: Coil supply aur contactor par connector ki fitting check karein.

solutions.en: Contact your Victron dealer quoting E-B26 before replacing the contactor yourself.
solutions.ur: Apne aap contactor badalne se pehle Victron dealer se E-B26 batakar rabta karein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes

meaning.en: Fault in the M8 battery cabling that the BMS relies on.
meaning.ur: BMS jis par depend karta hai us M8 battery cabling mein fault hai.

causes.en: Loose or corroded M8 battery terminal
causes.ur: Dheela ya corroded M8 battery terminal

causes.en: M8 cable damaged, undersized or of wrong type
causes.ur: M8 cable kharab, chhoti ya galat type ki

solutions.en: Isolate DC, then check the battery M8 cabling as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein, phir manual ke mutabiq battery M8 cabling check karein.

solutions.en: Clean every M8 terminal with a wire brush and re-tighten to the specified torque.
solutions.ur: Har M8 terminal ko wire brush se saaf karke specified torque par dobara tighten karein.

solutions.en: Measure the M8 connection resistance; it should be milliohms, not ohms.
solutions.ur: M8 connection ki resistance nikaalein; ye milliohms honi chahiye, ohms nahi.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes

meaning.en: The configured system voltage does not match the connected bank.
meaning.ur: Configured system voltage jury bank se match nahi karti.

causes.en: Battery voltage settings in VictronConnect set to 12/24/48 V incorrectly
causes.ur: VictronConnect mein battery voltage settings 12/24/48 V ki ghalat value par hain

causes.en: Bank replaced with a different nominal voltage
causes.ur: Bank ko kisi aur nominal voltage wale bank se badal diya gaya

solutions.en: Measure the actual bank voltage with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se asal bank voltage nikaalein.

solutions.en: Open the battery settings in VictronConnect and set the correct system voltage.
solutions.ur: VictronConnect mein battery settings kholein aur sahi system voltage set karein.

solutions.en: Re-read the error after saving to confirm E-B34 has cleared.
solutions.ur: Save karne ke baad error dobara parh kar confirm karein ke E-B34 saaf ho gaya.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes

meaning.en: The load capacity is too high for the BMS to finish pre-charging in time.
meaning.ur: Load capacity itni zyada hai ke BMS waqt par pre-charge khatam nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: Total connected load capacitance too large
causes.ur: Total connected load capacitance bohat badi hai

causes.en: Loads and chargers all switched in together during pre-charge
causes.ur: Pre-charge ke dauran loads aur chargers sab aik saath on kar diye gaye

solutions.en: Isolate DC, then disconnect some DC loads as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein, phir manual ke mutabiq kuch DC loads disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Stagger the loads: bring them on in stages rather than all together.
solutions.ur: Loads ko stage mein laayein, sab aik saath nahi.

solutions.en: Reconnect and confirm the pre-charge completes within the BMS timeout.
solutions.ur: Dobara jurayein aur confirm karein ke pre-charge BMS timeout ke andar complete hota hai.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes

meaning.en: The auxiliary ATC or ATD contact is not being read correctly by the BMS.
meaning.ur: BMS auxiliary ATC ya ATD contact ko theek se nahi parh raha.

causes.en: ATC/ATD wiring fault or a loose auxiliary contact connector
causes.ur: ATC/ATD wiring fault ya auxiliary contact connector dheela

causes.en: Loads or chargers not actually controlled by the ATC or ATD
causes.ur: Loads ya chargers asal mein ATC ya ATD se control nahi ho rahe

solutions.en: Isolate DC, then check the ATC/ATD wiring at both the contactor and the BMS.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein, phir contactor aur BMS dono par ATC/ATD wiring check karein.

solutions.en: Confirm every load and charger is genuinely wired to the ATC or ATD, per the manual.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq confirm karein ke har load aur charger wakai ATC ya ATD se jury hai.

solutions.en: Measure the auxiliary contact state with a multimeter; it must switch cleanly on and off.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se auxiliary contact ki state nikaalein; ye on aur off par saaf switch honi chahiye.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes

meaning.en: The BMS calibration data is lost and the unit needs dealer attention.
meaning.ur: BMS ka calibration data kho gaya hai aur unit ko dealer ke dekhne ki zaroorat hai.

causes.en: Calibration memory corrupted or lost
causes.ur: Calibration memory corrupt ya kho gaya

causes.en: Factory-fresh unit logging this once in history before first clear
causes.ur: Factory naya unit pehli clear se pehle aik baar history mein ye log kar raha hai

solutions.en: Check whether E-B116 is the ACTIVE error or only sits in the history log.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke E-B116 ACTIVE error hai ya sirf history log mein hai.

solutions.en: If ACTIVE, contact your Victron dealer for a replacement.
solutions.ur: Agar ACTIVE hai to Victron dealer se replacement ke liye rabta karein.

solutions.en: If history only and the BMS runs normally, no action is needed.
solutions.ur: Agar sirf history mein hai aur BMS normal chalta hai to koi karam nahi.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes

meaning.en: Settings data is corrupt. The manual's remedy is to reset to defaults from the settings page.
meaning.ur: Settings data corrupt hai. Manual ka hal hai settings page se defaults par reset karna.

causes.en: Settings memory corrupted, often after an interrupted write or power cut
causes.ur: Settings memory corrupt, aksar interrupted write ya power cut ke baad

causes.en: Firmware update interrupted part-way
causes.ur: Firmware update beech mein ruk gaya

solutions.en: Open the settings page in VictronConnect and reset to defaults.
solutions.ur: VictronConnect mein settings page kholein aur defaults par reset karein.

solutions.en: Power down the BMS fully, wait 3 minutes, then power up and reconfigure.
solutions.ur: BMS ko mukammal band karein, 3 minute intezaar karein, phir on karke dobara configure karein.

solutions.en: Re-enter your battery type, capacity and system voltage after the reset.
solutions.ur: Reset ke baad battery type, capacity aur system voltage dobara daalein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes
